name: tower_survey
description: GOVERNOR'S EYES over the WHOLE tower. Call with no args for a tower-wide survey: active vs idle floor counts, stale floors (idle >1h), cold floors (idle >24h) with their labels, skeleton/fit-out-pending floor cards, the Council board counts (open/in_progress/blocked/done), and open worker-needs count. Call with {floor: N} for a deep dive on ONE floor: its label, active state, last-activity age, live signal, and card status. Grounded verbatim from qsb_floor_activity_index.json + floor cards + the board snapshot. Use this BEFORE answering ANY 'what's the state of floor N / the whole tower / what's idle / what needs doing' question so Wren governs from real per-floor data, never a guess.
